description: Support unified ACP agent prompt specs with structured rendering, pluggable prompt loaders, and lazy OpenSpec task prompt composition.

tasks.title: Add prompt resolver core
tasks.description: Implement the runner prompt core with prompt spec types, a prompt loader registry, structured prompt rendering, and resolver behavior for string, plain object, and loader-backed prompts. Include test hooks so unit tests can register fake prompt loaders without affecting production defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: String prompt specs resolve byte-for-byte unchanged.
Plain object prompt specs render through a stable XML-like renderer with deterministic tags, attributes, whitespace, and list handling.
Prompt specs with uses resolve through a registered loader and normalize string or object loader results to final prompt text.
Unknown prompt loaders and invalid prompt objects fail with clear errors.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/core/prompt.ts plus prompt renderer and resolver unit tests
tasks.notes: Keep the renderer LLM-friendly rather than strict XML. Stable output is more important than full serialization semantics.

tasks.title: Resolve ACP agent prompt specs
tasks.description: Update the `mohist/acp-agent` action to resolve `context.with.prompt` through the new prompt resolver before applying the existing Mohist issue context wrapper. Preserve the legacy fallback prompt path when `with.prompt` is absent.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing string prompt behavior remains unchanged before the Mohist issue context wrapper is applied.
Plain object and loader-backed prompt specs are resolved before the existing issue context wrapper is added.
Tasks without `with.prompt` still use `buildFallbackPrompt(context)`.
The prompt loader context includes loader config, workflow variables, work directory, work id, title, stage, and issue number where available.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts integrated with prompt resolution and updated tests
tasks.notes: Do not move prompt resolution into the workflow runtime or alter WorkItem wire shape.

tasks.title: Add OpenSpec task prompt loader
tasks.description: Implement and register the built-in `mohist/openspec-task-prompt` loader. It should read a JSON task file relative to the work directory, locate the task array by dotted path, select by `taskId` or fallback `index`, and return structured prompt data containing optional base instructions and the selected task fields.
acceptanceCriteria: The loader selects by `taskId` matching either `id` or `taskId`, and `taskId` takes precedence over a provided index.
The loader selects by zero-based `index` when `taskId` is absent.
Missing files, missing item paths, missing selectors, and missing selected tasks produce clear errors.
A configured `base` prompt is embedded in the returned prompt data.
Task field values containing literal template syntax such as `${{ prompts.xxx }}` are preserved as ordinary JSON data.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/openspec-task-prompt.ts, packages/runner/src/core/prompt-registry.ts, and openspec task prompt unit tests
tasks.notes: Resolve `file` relative to `workDir`. Prefer returning an object so shared structured rendering covers final prompt formatting.

tasks.title: Thin OpenSpec task loader output
tasks.description: Update `mohist/openspec-tasks` so it only materializes runtime ACP agent tasks and injects a `with.prompt.uses: mohist/openspec-task-prompt` spec when the caller did not provide an explicit prompt. Ensure generated tasks use per-task selectors while keeping JSON-loaded task content out of generated `with` values.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated default runtime tasks use `mohist/acp-agent` and include `with.prompt.uses` set to `mohist/openspec-task-prompt`.
The injected prompt loader configuration includes the task file, items path, base prompt when configured, and a per-task `taskId` selector when available.
Existing explicit `task.with.prompt` values are preserved unchanged for string, plain object, and loader-backed forms.
The loader no longer composes or assigns a literal prompt string in the default path.
The existing documentation-field pollution regression test still passes and task descriptions with literal `${{ prompts.xxx }}` are not embedded into generated `with` data.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/openspec.ts and updated openspec loader tests
tasks.notes: Keep existing loader input keys backward compatible. Only the default prompt composition path should move.

tasks.title: Update default build workflow prompt shape
tasks.description: Update the built-in default OpenSpec build workflow so the Build stage expresses prompt composition through `mohist/openspec-task-prompt`. The workflow should pass task file, items path, base build prompt, and ACP agent configuration while preserving the existing stage semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: The default Build stage `mohist/openspec-tasks` configuration is expressible with `task.uses: mohist/acp-agent`.
The configured task prompt uses `mohist/openspec-task-prompt` with file, items, and base prompt inputs.
Existing OpenSpec task loader keys remain valid and no unrelated Plan, Check, or Integrate semantics change.
Explicit prompt overrides in task loader configuration still take precedence over the default injected prompt loader spec.
tasks.notes: Limit workflow edits to the Build stage prompt composition shape unless tests expose a required adjacent update.

tasks.title: Verify runner prompt integration
tasks.description: Complete runner-level verification for the unified prompt resolver and OpenSpec loader integration. Run the package build and test suites, address failures caused by this change, and ensure coverage proves backward compatibility and the lazy prompt-loading contract.
acceptanceCriteria: `npm run build` passes in `packages/runner`.
`npm test` passes in `packages/runner`.
Tests cover string prompt identity, object-to-XML rendering, fake loader resolution, loader returning string, and loader returning object.
Tests cover `mohist/openspec-task-prompt` selection by `taskId`, selection by `index`, missing selector or file errors, and embedded base prompt output.
Tests cover `mohist/openspec-tasks` generated prompt loader specs and preservation of explicit prompt overrides.
tasks.output: Passing packages/runner build and test results with updated test coverage
tasks.notes: This task consumes outputs from all implementation tasks and should be last.
